'''Nave''' was a three-leaved [[Plant/Legends|plant]] imported to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. As a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] product, its leaves were wrapped around [[nyork]] meat. Nave generally grew in watery [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]].
